description: In a quiet cul-de-sac without traffic, former workshop and vaulted cellars from 1840 transformed into a flexible apartment.In the heart of the 11th arrondissement, this residential and shopping district is very lively both during the day and in the evening. The population is rather young and made up of many expatriate students or young workers.The location allows you to get around on foot: the Marais, Père Lachaise, the Grands Boulevards or the Saint Martin canal...Public transport nearby.The spaceThe entrance is directly from the impasse in the living room: fitted kitchen, living room, dining room and WC. At the back of the room you can access a courtyard shared with the neighbors on the ground floor.The 2 bedrooms, the office and the bathroom (with WC) are located in the basement.One of the bedrooms has a double bed (160cm) and has a TV. The other bedroom offers 4 beds: a double bed (120cm) and two single beds (90cm) including one bunk and one with a drawer. These 4 beds are designed for children or adults of moderate build.Additional sleeping is also possible on the sofa in the living room.Guest accessAll the accommodation is accessible except the dressing room (which contains our personal belongings since we live in this apartment) as well as the cellar (which contains our bottles of wine)Other things to notePlease note: there are no windows in the basement, just window wells and central ventilation.
